specifications.name: descriptionHtml
specifications.value:
Birkenstock Shoe Cleaner Set - 4 Pack

Keep your favorite kicks in tip-top shape with the Shoe Cleaner set from Birkenstock. This pack comes complete with a handy brush and three different products that are designed to clean, protect, and refresh your favorite styles.

Instructions:

Cleaner & Refresher:

Synthetic or leather footbeds: spray the entire footbed, wipe away moisture and dirt with a cloth. Wait until completely dry before wearing.

Suede or nubuck footbeds: spray the entire footbed. Wipe away excess moisture and dirt. Allow to dry completely. Back brush with a nylon bristle brush to raise the nap or texture

Water and Stain Repellent:

Check color fastness before applying. Footwear must have a dry clean surface, free from dust, dirt, and grease. Hold container six inches from surface and spray in a back-and-forth motion. Do not saturate. Be sure to spray area thoroughly and evenly, including all seams. Let dry for 24 hours.

Cork sealer:

Birkenstock Cork Sealer keeps cork from drying out and getting brittle, while locking out moisture and protecting it from undue wear caused by the elements. It dries clear in 15 minutes and cleans up with water. Apply a very thin film to CORK SURFACES ONLY. Reapply when needed or every 2-4 months.
